goal: Is ke baad aap bata sakein ge ke variable kahan use ho sakta hai (scope) aur kitni der zinda rehta hai (lifetime), globals kyun khatarnak hain, aur static local variable se function calls ke darmiyan value yaad rakhna seekh sakein ge.
warmup: Hostel socho. Aap ke kamre ke andar chipka hua notice sirf kamre ke log parhte hain: yeh local variable hai. Main gate par laga notice sab parhte hain: yeh global variable hai, aur sab us par kuch likh bhi sakte hain, is liye gari bari ho jati hai. Ab canteen ka token counter socho. Cashier har customer ke liye 1 se dobara shuru nahi karta. Counter aakhri number yaad rakhta hai. Static variable function ko isi tarah ki yaaddasht deta hai.
definition: Scope program ka woh hissa hai jahan variable ka naam use ho sakta hai. Local variable function ke andar ya { } block ke andar declare hota hai. Woh sirf wahin use ho sakta hai (block scope). Global variable saare functions ke bahar declare hota hai aur apne neeche ke har function mein use ho sakta hai. Lifetime ka matlab hai ke variable ka box kitni der maujood rehta hai. Aam local variable har dafa block chalne par banta hai aur khatam hone par destroy ho jata hai. Static local variable sirf ek dafa banta hai aur set up hota hai, aur poore program mein apni value rakhta hai, halankay sirf us ka apna function usay dekh sakta hai.
howItWorks: Scope trace kholen aur call stack panel dekhein. Global total har function ke bahar apni alag jagah par hota hai. Jab { } block shuru hota hai to naya x nazar aata hai aur bahar wale x ko chhupa deta hai. Block khatam hone par woh ghayab ho jata hai. main ke andar local total global total ko chhupa deta hai, lekin function show() ka apna koi total nahi hai, is liye woh global wala use karta hai. Isay shadowing kehte hain: sab se qareebi declaration jeet jati hai. Ab counter trace kholen. Aam variable normal har call par 0 se dobara banta hai, is liye hamesha 1 rehta hai. Static variable calls sirf ek dafa banta hai. Line static int calls = 0; sirf pehli dafa chalti hai. Baad ki calls mein woh chhor di jati hai aur calls ginta rehta hai. Globals se kyun bachein? Koi bhi function unhein badal sakta hai, is liye jab value ghalat ho to pata nahi chalta ke kis ne badli. Aise function ko dobara use karna bhi mushkil hota hai jo kisi global par depend kare. Local variables ko tarjeeh dein aur values parameters aur return ke zariye bhejein.
